content:
Platform ownership and bank routing are recorded on stores. An acquisition agreement must be assessed for that store, be signed, and identify the receiving account entity as the new owner.

propose_platform_cutover schedules acknowledgement after 20 minutes. Until acknowledgement the store is CUTOVER_PENDING; after it, the new entity, collection account and routing version become active together.

This does not alter settlements already transmitted under the previous routing version.
